name: Publish CK3 CoA editor to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/**"
      - ".github/workflows/coat-of-arms-editor-pages.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  # Only the newest editor commit should consume the single Pages deployment
  # lane. Frozen benchmark artifacts preserve superseded run evidence.
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Configure Pages
        id: pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: 10.12.1
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Verify authorized exact-build asset pack
        run: python tools/verify_web_asset_pack.py public/asset-packs/ck3-1.19.0.6

      - name: Verify frozen Delta-Q quality benchmark
        run: python tools/gen_fit_quality_benchmark.py --check

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Verify frozen seven-picture mixed-element evidence
        working-directory: .
        run: python coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/tools/summarize_mixed_element_evidence.py docs/coat-of-arms-fit-artifacts/user-picture-corpus-v14-pareto-budget-1024 docs/coat-of-arms-fit-artifacts/user-picture-corpus-v14-native-r18/summary.json docs/coat-of-arms-fit-artifacts/user-picture-corpus-v14-pareto-budget-1024/mixed-element-ablation.json --check

      - name: Build production acceptance artifact
        run: pnpm build
        env:
          VITE_BASE_PATH: "/"
          VITE_COA_CACHE_VERSION: "${{ github.sha }}"
          VITE_COA_GIT_HASH: "${{ github.sha }}"
          VITE_DISABLE_SERVICE_WORKER: "true"

      - name: Verify zero-backend production bundle
        run: pnpm verify:production-boundary

      - name: Install headless browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit

      - name: Run production browser acceptance
        env:
          COA_E2E_USE_PREVIEW: "true"
          # GitHub-hosted CPU performance is recorded but is not the frozen
          # maintainer-workstation performance reference.
          COA_E2E_PERFORMANCE_GATE: "report-only"
        run: |
          pnpm exec playwright test e2e/fit-budget-stress.spec.ts
          pnpm exec playwright test e2e/standalone-image-fit.spec.ts
          pnpm exec playwright test \
            e2e/candidate-comparison.spec.ts \
            e2e/editor-recovery.spec.ts \
            e2e/fit-cancel-stages.spec.ts \
            e2e/i18n.spec.ts \
            e2e/large-document-stress.spec.ts \
            e2e/mobile-layout.spec.ts \
            e2e/parent-preview-boundary.spec.ts \
            e2e/portable-fit-checkpoint.spec.ts \
            e2e/production-no-backend.spec.ts \
            e2e/safe-svg-input.spec.ts \
            e2e/textured-emblem-preview.spec.ts \
            e2e/visual-transform-editor.spec.ts

      - name: Run source-module WebGL and Delta-Q acceptance
        run: pnpm exec playwright test e2e/webgl-batch-scorer.spec.ts e2e/perceptual-metric-calibration.spec.ts e2e/perceptual-real-baseline.spec.ts e2e/perceptual-final-candidates.spec.ts e2e/asset-retrieval-holdout.spec.ts e2e/structure-search-holdout.spec.ts

      - name: Run cross-browser core acceptance
        run: pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.cross-browser.config.ts
        env:
          COA_E2E_USE_PREVIEW: "true"

      - name: Build service worker acceptance artifact
        run: pnpm build
        env:
          VITE_BASE_PATH: "/"
          VITE_COA_CACHE_VERSION: "${{ github.sha }}"
          VITE_COA_GIT_HASH: "${{ github.sha }}"

      - name: Run service worker offline acceptance
        run: pnpm exec playwright test e2e/service-worker-offline.spec.ts
        env:
          COA_E2E_USE_PREVIEW: "true"

      - name: Build Pages artifact
        run: pnpm build
        env:
          VITE_BASE_PATH: "${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_path }}/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/"
          VITE_COA_CACHE_VERSION: "${{ github.sha }}"
          VITE_COA_GIT_HASH: "${{ github.sha }}"

      - name: Stage and verify nested Pages artifact
        run: |
          test -f dist/index.html
          python tools/verify_web_asset_pack.py dist/asset-packs/ck3-1.19.0.6
          grep -F '${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_path }}/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/' dist/index.html
          mkdir -p pages-site/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3
          cp -a dist/. pages-site/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/
          test -f pages-site/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/index.html
          python tools/verify_web_asset_pack.py pages-site/coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/asset-packs/ck3-1.19.0.6

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: coat_of_arms_editer_of_ck3/pages-site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
